The attack was widely telegraphed in advance, giving Israel, the US, UK, France, and Jordan time to coordinate a multilayered defensive response. The overwhelming majority of munitions were intercepted.

Israel's multi-tier defense (Arrow, David's Sling, Iron Dome) achieved a near-total interception rate with coalition support.

damage: Kindergarten/daycare facility in Ramle struck and damaged. Infrastructure damage in Ramle. No warning sirens sounded.
proxy_description: Hezbollah long-range missile barrage coordinated with ongoing Iranian True Promise 4 operations. Assessed as intended to distract from Iran conflict and stretch Israeli air defenses.
description: Thirty-fourth wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 10 (March 9), evening. Hezbollah long-range missile barrage targeting central Israel. 16 lightly wounded in Ramle including from kindergarten hit. Hezbollah claimed targets were IDF Home Front Command HQ (Rehavam Base) in Ramle and satellite communications station in Haela Valley near Beit Shemesh.

wave_codename_english: First Wave Under the New Ayatollah
payload: Ballistic missile with cluster warhead; submunitions dispersed across 6+ sites
targets: Yehud (construction site — primary impact, 1 killed, 2 seriously wounded); Or Yehuda; Holon; Bat Yam; Rishon Letzion (1 moderately wounded)
interception_report: Cluster warhead submunitions not intercepted; multiple impact sites across central Israel. No specific interception details reported for this salvo.
damage: Construction site in Yehud struck. Submunitions impacted across six sites in Yehud, Or Yehuda, Holon, Bat Yam, and Rishon Letzion. Two construction workers killed at Yehud site (Rustam Gulomov and Amid Murtuzov, both in their 40s, residents of Petah Tikva). One man seriously wounded in Or Yehuda.
description: Thirty-fifth wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 11 (March 10), overnight. IRGC launched ballistic missile with cluster warhead at central Israel. Submunitions scattered across at least six sites in Yehud, Or Yehuda, Holon, Bat Yam, and Rishon Letzion. One man killed at construction site in Yehud, two men seriously wounded at same site. Woman moderately wounded by debris in Rishon Letzion. Iranian state broadcaster IRIB hailed this as the 'first wave of missiles under Mojtaba Khamenei towards occupied territories.'
iranian_media_claims: IRIB hailed attack as 'first wave of missiles under Mojtaba Khamenei towards occupied territories.' Described as cluster bomb warhead striking central Israel.

targets: Qatar — likely targeting Al Udeid Air Base and other US military facilities
interception_systems: Arrow-2, Arrow-3, Iron Dome, David's Sling, THAAD, Patriot PAC-3, Aegis BMD / SM-3
interception_report: Qatar Armed Forces successfully intercepted all 17 ballistic missiles and 6 drones. No casualties or damage reported. Qatar MoD released video of interceptions.
damage: No damage reported. All projectiles intercepted.
description: Thirty-sixth wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 11 (March 10). IRGC launched 17 ballistic missiles and 6 drones at Qatar. Qatar Armed Forces successfully intercepted all incoming projectiles with no casualties or damage reported. Part of ongoing Iranian targeting of Gulf States hosting US military assets. Qatari Ministry of Defence released video of interceptions.

Sirens sounded across Jerusalem, West Bank, and parts of southern Israel. Reports of impacts in Beit Shemesh area. Magen David Adom initially reported no injuries. Concurrent with Hezbollah rocket fire on Haifa Bay area. Tentative reports of fires near impact sites.
